newsitem.title: USA: Preferred Networks names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Preferred Networks names new CFO.

text.p: Preferred Networks Inc said Monday that Chief Financial Officer Kim Smith Hughes has resigned.
The company said it has named Kathryn Loev Putnam as her successor.
Most recently, Putnam was vice president of corporate development at Preferred Networks, which provides outsourcing solutions to the wireless industry.

Chairman and Chief Executive Mark Dunaway said in a statement that Hughes resigned because "Kim and her husband have been commuting between Atlanta and Florida for almost two years and have decided to live in Florida on a full-time basis."
